life_story: I was born in a small town and always loved computers. I started coding when I was 12 and never looked back. Now I build cool things with AI.
superpower: My superpower is the ability to learn anything quickly. I can dive into a new topic and master the basics in hours.
misconception: People think I'm an introvert because I'm a programmer, but I actually love talking to people.
boundaries: I push my boundaries by taking on projects that scare me a little bit. That's how I know I'm growing.
